about_short_description.short_description: Deloz is a sales automation platform that helps companies to streamline their sales process and globally scale their businesses.

product.name: Sales Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that manages the entire sales cycle including lead collection, follow-up, automated emails, conversion, and customer retention.

product.name: VOIP Calling with Local Numbers
product.description: A VOIP calling service providing local phone numbers in over 150 countries to facilitate global business communication.

product.name: Shared Inbox
product.description: A shared email inbox that allows real-time visibility and assignment of sales-related communications among team members.

product.name: Email Workflow Automation
product.description: A tool to set rules for sending periodic and scheduled emails to nurture leads and maintain customer relationships.

product.name: Sales Activity and Performance Tracking
product.description: A system to monitor sales activities, track representative performance, and analyze sales data for decision-making.
